testCase.name: [local] S22 A browser with the wrong date and time zone: Save Note's 'today' labels follow the server (web half)

descriptionHtml:
Bug B18 · P1 · known

Many dates and times follow the device clock instead of server time (UAT 3.8): 'NEW TODAY', admit date, vitals date, task done time, transcript date; with a phone two days slow a held drug is stamped two days back and the next cleanup deletes it

Tickets: TFA-92584 ready for qa (UAT 3.8) · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local

Note: Root cause known (Daniela asked for server time on 10-03); the deleted drug, missing badge and wrong draft restore are new symptoms

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-01/S08, TC-12/S23, TC-19/S19, TC-22/S23, TC-25/S24a, TC-02/S13b, EFS/S28, TC-16/S25

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S22 A browser with the wrong date and time zone: Save Note's 'today' labels follow the server (web half)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U12 Time rules that Save Note touches ('today' on the course line, today's vitals/labs column, the 12 h window) use the server clock; … (UAT 3.8)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given Local stack (http://localhost:6473) and a make-session-style @roundai.test account; two Playwright browser contexts on the same patient and resident: one correct, one with page.clock.setFixedTime(server now + 2 days) and timezoneId 'Pacific/Honolulu'

When Save Note the S01 text (Hospital) and the S02 text (Nursing Home) from the shifted context, then read the chart and compare with what the correct context writes

Then The course line's day label and today's vitals/labs column (vitalsHistory date, Nursing Home vitalsDate) carry the server's date, the same as from the correct context

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions against 3.8: day label and dates equal the server-clock values. Code read predicts a Fail: todayLabel() and new Date().toDateString() in both hooks, and preRoundVintageTag in src/domain/noteContext.ts, use the device clock; the day roll part is known: TFA-92584. The phone half is S04

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S22 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: New product issue · environment local · tickets none (UAT only)

On a device whose clock is two days ahead, Save Note files today's vitals and labs under the device's date (a column for Oct 15 while the server says Oct 14). The same Save Note dates the course line by the server.

Evidence: allure ac2766b7, Playwright context shifted to Pacific/Honolulu +2 days. The vitals/labs column and the NH vitalsDate read 'Thu Oct 15 2026'; a correct device gives Wed Oct 14. Cause: new Date().toDateString() in usePreRoundProcess.ts:193 and useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts:191. This breaks UAT 3.8 (TC-10 U12, which has no gate ticket). TC-10 risks predicted it, but it is not in the dev report, the ledger or any knownGaps. OAT-04 K10 covers the same browser-clock class for retention stamps (TFA-94699 AC 7, in progress), the likely home for a fix. The course-line time-zone part is TC-11 Q4, already recorded.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · Section: A2 · Pre-Round · Scenario: TC-10/S22

A browser with the wrong date and time zone: Save Note's 'today' labels follow the server (web half)

Tickets: none (UAT only)

New local lane newspec-b: status failed in newspec-b/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue; part of it is a known gap)).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Chromium spec, fresh account: a correct context and one with the device clock +2 days and timezoneId Pacific/Honolulu (page.clock.install); Save Note with the parse answered at the socket (fixed values). Before pressing Save the spec waits for the app's own server-time ask (time:now mutation, recorded at the socket) to be answered, as it would be while a physician types; the ask's result is recorded. Assert the course line's day label, today's vitalsHistory/labsHistory date and NH vitalsDate equal the server's day (either time zone accepted, TC-11 Q4). — Device clock and time zone are browser-context settings; the server-time answer is observed on the sync socket.

Detail:

Re-run 17:26 after a test fix: the spec now waits for the app's own server-time ask (time:now, src/data/time.ts) to be answered before pressing Save Note — it answered 0.55–0.72 s after the page load, success, in both contexts. Why: in the 17:07 re-run the spec typed with fill() and pressed Save before that answer, so the Nursing Home course line also carried the device's day ('Visit 1 · Oct 15'); the app reads the device clock until the server answers, and no physician types a pre-round note in 0.6 s, so that was a test artifact (recorded, not judged). With the answer in: course line 'Oct 13: …' / 'Visit 1 · Oct 13: …' = the server's day read in Honolulu (time-zone part recorded, TC-11 Q4); correct device 'Oct 14'. Fails: today's vitals and labs columns 'Thu Oct 15 2026' and Nursing Home vitalsDate 'Thu Oct 15 2026' (the device's day; correct device: Wed Oct 14 2026). Parse answered at the socket with fixed values.

Product issue: known: open PR #100 (TFA-92592), not on main — commit 0b738c0 'a value's day is read on the corrected clock' switches usePreRoundProcess / useSnfPreRoundProcess 'today' from new Date() to clockNow(); .agents/qa-project-context.md lists '#100 dated vitals/labs' under open PRs. On main: a device two days ahead files today's vitals and labs under the device's date (a column for a day that has not happened), while the same Save Note dates the course line by the server. Breaks TC-10 U12 (UAT 3.8). Re-check when #100 merges.

Known gap (known): PR #100 (TFA-92592), not on main

Evidence: 4 attached; 1 not attached:

  • newspec-b/rerun-fix2-tc10-s22.log — .log files are not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A (our chromium spec, not written yet): two Playwright contexts with page.clock and timezoneId on a fresh @roundai.test account made with the local admin key; dev has no admin key and one shared account, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
